sections.title: Advanced Shortcuts & Editorial Productivity
content: In high-tempo editorial rooms, speed and muscle memory are everything. InCopy permits deep keyboard customization and macro mapping for repetitive phrasing and character cleanup.
Under Edit > Keyboard Shortcuts, editors can tailor a custom keyboard profile, reducing multi-click actions to instant key chords.

sections.title: Complex Data Tables & Pre-press Export
content: Managing statistical reports and complex multi-page tables can be tedious. InCopy provides complete control over row insertions, header repeats, cell formatting, and tabular alignments.
Pro Tip: Always synchronize Table and Cell Styles directly linked from InDesign master packages instead of applying ad-hoc manual cell borders.
